headings.h1: Mark and HighlightText for literal relevance

intro: Highlight matching text while preserving its original characters, casing and whitespace.
useCases: Search results, filtered lists and command palettes that show matched text.

faqs.question: Is an animation package required?
faqs.answer: No. Mark and HighlightText do not require an animation package or a measurement hook.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body: HighlightText accepts one or multiple literal queries. Empty queries are ignored; longest matches at the same start win. Case-insensitive matching uses Unicode simple case folding, without accent normalization or locale-specific equivalence.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: Mark indicates relevance; screen readers do not necessarily announce its boundaries. Do not use color alone to explain a result.
